test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language. 'WMHKRDFL' is written as 'RGACMXYD'. What is the code for 'RSLTKQMN' in that code language?
solution:
Table of alphabets place value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/286550159bb1b1af83b0ffca14b226c7cea8abbacc574e15aefc51c80aadcc47.png] 

The pattern follows here,

'WMHKRDFL' is written as 'RGACMXYD'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b4f2a105f6f7af58ccdde46eb93f71b6b8a8f60e316b41aab5aff7810c6c5ca0.png] 

**Similarly,**

'RSLTKQMN' is written as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f776714e15b19f03de9d592f93dc2d22cbaf433fa4f8134feee792b4a72992f8.png] 

Hence, **'RSLTKQMN'** is coded as **'MMELFKFF'**
